detail.title: Architectural Trade-Offs in Vision-Only FSD and Sensor-Fusion Chip Design: Memory Bandwidth, Cache Capacity, and Competitive Dynamics in Autonomous Driving Semiconductors

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently without any commercial or financial relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted as independent research by the author.

detail.abstract: This paper examines architectural trade-offs in autonomous driving chip design through the lens of Tesla-style vision-only Full Self-Driving (FSD) systems versus sensor-fusion robotaxi stacks. Focusing on memory hierarchy behavior, cache capacity, and DRAM technology choices (LPDDR versus HBM), the study investigates how end-to-end (E2E) architectures shape both technical performance and competitive dynamics among US, Chinese, and Taiwanese semiconductor suppliers. Using GPU profiling experiments on Tesla T4 hardware, real-world driving data from a BMW X6 equipped with Mobileye EyeQ2, and comparative cost structure analysis, the research addresses two questions: (1) how memory bandwidth requirements differ between sequential and parallel E2E architectures representative of FSD-style stacks, and (2) how these differences interact with cost structures to segment markets between vision-only LPDDR systems and sensor-fusion HBM systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过特斯拉式纯视觉FSD系统与传感器融合Robotaxi架构的对比，研究自动驾驶芯片设计中的内存层次、缓存容量和DRAM技术选择（LPDDR vs HBM），分析端到端架构如何影响技术性能和美中台半导体供应商的竞争格局。
AI.research_question: 1. 代表FSD风格堆栈的串行与并行端到端架构之间的内存带宽需求有何差异？2. 这些差异如何与成本结构相互作用，将市场细分为纯视觉LPDDR系统和传感器融合HBM系统？
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶芯片设计中存在架构权衡，特别是特斯拉纯视觉FSD系统与传感器融合robotaxi堆栈的对比，这些设计选择不仅影响技术性能，还塑造美中台半导体供应商的竞争动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 端到端架构理论、内存层次理论、缓存容量优化理论、DRAM技术选择理论、市场竞争细分理论。
AI.method: 1. 在Tesla T4硬件上进行GPU性能分析实验；2. 使用配备Mobileye EyeQ2的宝马X6采集真实驾驶数据；3. 进行对比成本结构分析。
AI.findings: 串行与并行端到端架构在内存带宽需求上存在显著差异，这些差异与成本结构相互作用，导致市场细分：纯视觉系统倾向于采用LPDDR技术，而传感器融合系统则更适合HBM技术。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了自动驾驶芯片架构与内存技术选择的关联理论；2. 提出了端到端架构类型与市场细分之间的理论框架；3. 丰富了半导体供应链竞争动态的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为芯片设计者提供架构选择与内存技术匹配的实用指南；2. 帮助半导体供应商识别不同市场细分的技术需求；3. 为自动驾驶系统集成商提供成本效益分析框架。

title: Entropy Alignment: A Framework for Governing Randomness in AI-Enabled Enterprise Systems

detail.title: Entropy Alignment: A Framework for Governing Randomness in AI-Enabled Enterprise Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or commercial relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest with respect to the research, authorship, or publication of this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or identifiable personal data. As a conceptual and theoretical work, ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
As artificial intelligence systems move from experimental deployments into operational and decision-critical enterprise environments, organizations struggle to balance automation, predictability, creativity, and trust. Existing AI governance frameworks emphasize ethics, transparency, and risk mitigation, yet often fail to provide a unifying technical principle that explains how and where uncertainty should be permitted within intelligent systems.

This paper introduces Entropy Alignment, a systems-level framework that treats entropy as the controlled application of randomness across different layers of AI-enabled enterprise systems. Drawing from thermodynamics, information theory, cryptography, cybernetics, and modern machine learning, we argue that effective AI modernization is not a question of maximizing or minimizing intelligence, but of intentionally placing randomness according to business intent.

We show that automation corresponds to near-zero entropy, adaptive intelligence requires bounded entropy, and ungoverned systems drift toward pathological high-entropy behaviors such as hallucination and instability. By framing AI behavior through entropy profiles rather than model classes or vendor capabilities, organizations gain a practical mechanism for aligning predictability, innovation, and trust. The framework offers actionable guidance for enterprise AI governance, system design, and risk containment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"熵对齐"框架，将熵视为AI系统中可控的随机性应用，通过在不同层级有意放置随机性来平衡自动化、适应性和信任，而非单纯追求智能最大化或最小化。
AI.research_question: 如何在AI企业系统中平衡自动化、可预测性、创造性和信任？如何通过统一的技术原则来指导AI系统中不确定性的合理应用？
AI.motivation: 现有AI治理框架强调伦理、透明度和风险缓解，但缺乏解释智能系统中应在何处以及如何允许不确定性的统一技术原则。随着AI系统从实验部署转向运营和决策关键的企业环境，组织面临平衡自动化、可预测性、创造性和信任的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 熵对齐框架，融合热力学、信息论、密码学、控制论和现代机器学习理论，将熵视为AI系统中可控的随机性应用。
AI.method: 系统级框架分析，通过熵剖面而非模型类别或供应商能力来框架化AI行为，提供企业AI治理、系统设计和风险控制的可操作指导。
AI.findings: 自动化对应接近零熵，自适应智能需要有限熵，无治理系统会漂向病态高熵行为（如幻觉和不稳定性）。通过熵剖面框架，组织可以获得对齐可预测性、创新和信任的实用机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出熵对齐作为AI治理的统一技术原则，将热力学、信息论等多学科理论应用于AI系统设计，提供基于熵剖面的AI行为分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业AI治理、系统设计和风险控制提供可操作指导，帮助组织根据业务意图有意放置随机性，平衡自动化、适应性和信任需求。

title: A Cybernetic Invariant Across Biological, Digital, and Organizational Intelligence

detail.title: A Cybernetic Invariant Across Biological, Digital, and Organizational Intelligence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial or personal interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or experimental interventions. As a conceptual and theoretical analysis, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Across biological brains, large-scale digital networks, and modern artificial intelligence systems, intelligence exhibits a recurring structural pattern: adaptive behavior emerges not from globally synchronized computation, but from selectively propagated signals operating within constrained, conditionally activated subspaces. This paper proposes a unifying cybernetic invariant governing intelligent systems operating under resource, energy, bandwidth, latency, and trust constraints.

Drawing from classical cybernetics, computational neuroscience, network theory, organizational systems, and contemporary transformer architectures, we argue that locality, conditional activation, feedback control, and bounded propagation are necessary conditions for scalable intelligence, rather than implementation preferences or architectural accidents. We formalize this invariant as a constraint-driven control principle, derive quantitative implications using control-theoretic and information-theoretic bounds, and demonstrate its manifestation across biological neural systems, internet-scale networks, modern AI models, and organizational execution architectures.

The framework yields falsifiable predictions regarding system stability, modularity, and scaling behavior, with direct implications for AI governance, enterprise control systems, and the design of resilient intelligent infrastructures. Rather than proposing a new algorithm or mechanism, this work offers a unifying explanatory framework that clarifies why intelligent systems consistently converge on sparse activation, modular organization, and gated execution across substrates.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一的控制论不变量，解释了智能系统在资源约束下为何普遍采用局部性、条件激活、反馈控制和有限传播的结构模式。
AI.research_question: 智能系统（包括生物大脑、数字网络和现代AI）为何在不同实现中都表现出局部性、条件激活、反馈控制和有限传播的结构模式？
AI.motivation: 观察到智能系统在资源、能量、带宽、延迟和信任约束下，普遍采用稀疏激活、模块化组织和门控执行的结构模式，需要统一的解释框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 控制论、计算神经科学、网络理论、组织系统理论和现代transformer架构。
AI.method: 形式化约束驱动控制原理，使用控制论和信息论界限推导定量含义，并在生物神经系统、互联网规模网络、现代AI模型和组织执行架构中验证。
AI.findings: 局部性、条件激活、反馈控制和有限传播是智能系统可扩展性的必要条件，而非实现偏好或架构偶然性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一的解释框架，阐明了智能系统在不同底层实现中为何一致地收敛于稀疏激活、模块化组织和门控执行。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI治理、企业控制系统和弹性智能基础设施设计提供直接指导，并产生关于系统稳定性、模块化和扩展行为的可证伪预测。

title: Vertical Restraints of Trade as Contractual Integration: A Synthesis of Relational Contracting Theory, Transaction-Cost Economics, and Organization Theory
affiliations: George Mason University - Antonin Scalia Law School and

detail.title: Vertical Restraints of Trade as Contractual Integration: A Synthesis of Relational Contracting Theory, Transaction-Cost Economics, and Organization Theory

publicationDetails.journalName: George Mason University Department of Economics Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: Law & Economics Center at George Mason University Scalia Law School Research Paper Series
publicationDetails.journalName: Law & Economics Center at George Mason University Scalia Law School Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: Emory Law Journal, Vol. 32, No. 4, pp. 1009–1109 (1983)

detail.abstract:
The Supreme Court's oscillating treatment of nonprice vertical restraints under the antitrust laws has been widely discussed. Although the Court has not developed a coherent, workable model for analyzing the legality of vertical restraints, a consensus as to the economic nature and function of these restraints has emerged. The most recent major swing in the Court's position—the return of the Rule of Reason in Continental T.V., Inc. v. GTE Sylvania, Inc.—embraced the following economic syllogism for evaluating antitrust doctrines: (1) the goal of antitrust policy is the promotion of consumer welfare; (2) consumer welfare is advanced by economic efficiency; therefore, (3) antitrust policy should not interfere with business practices that increase economic efficiency. Primarily because the adopted standard of efficiency has been consumer welfare, economics provides the most useful tool for the analysis of antitrust doctrines. Economic analyses of business practices categorized as vertical restraints have concentrated on ad hoc theoretical rationalizations for their adoption by firms, as well as theoretical analyses of their effects on economic efficiency—the main theme being the identification of situations where profit maximization and increased economic efficiency coincide. There are, however, some areas of antitrust, such as vertical restrictions, in which the general framework of economics can be profitably supplemented by other disciplines. Economists, because their fundamental unit of analysis is the firm, have neglected the logical processes by which businessmen decide to adopt and implement business practices related to the internal organization and external relationships of the firm. This neglect is unfortunate because analysis of vertical restraints at a lower level of abstraction, i.e., within the firm, may lead to additional insights into their efficiency implications and, thus, to a correct antitrust policy. 

Organization theory, a branch of the management sciences concerned with the analysis of factors that affect the decisions of managers to implement various business practices, can be especially useful in reaching policy decisions since it provides an explicit and practical explanation of many business practices. Interfirm relationships that would be classified as vertical restraints under antitrust law are included among the various practices and strategies studied by organization theorists. The contributions of organization theory, however, have not been applied to a policy analysis of antitrust law. Given the Supreme Court's recently adopted paradigm for evaluating the legality of business practices, a consideration of the attributes of business practices, which have been analyzed, categorized, and developed by organization theorists, will provide additional tools for the analysis of antitrust questions. Both economics and organization theory can be used to capture subtleties associated with the type of long-term contracts that characterize most vertical restrictions. Moreover, a synthesis of the economic and organization theory approaches can be formulated through an expansion of the traditional analysis of contract law to include long-term relational contracting theories. 

This article attempts to synthesize into a general theoretical framework the contributions of these various disciplines—contract law theory, economics, and organization theory—and apply the framework to the specific issues surrounding the antitrust law of vertical restraints. This general-theory-to-specific-application approach serves to emphasize the point that vertical restraints are merely a category of generic business practices that may enhance economic efficiency through a partial suppression of market forces." The efficiency-enhancing aspects of these business practices indicate that a proper antitrust policy should incorporate a strong, yet rebuttable, presumption of their legality.

AI.tldr: 本文主张在反垄断法对纵向限制的分析中，除了经济学方法外，还应整合组织理论和合同法理论，形成一个综合分析框架，以更全面地理解纵向限制的效率含义，从而制定更合理的反垄断政策。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个综合性的理论框架来分析反垄断法中的纵向限制问题，以弥补单纯经济学分析的不足？
AI.motivation: 美国最高法院对纵向限制的反垄断处理摇摆不定，缺乏连贯的分析模型。虽然经济学已成为主要分析工具，但其以企业为基本分析单位，忽视了企业内部决策过程和组织因素。需要整合其他学科来完善分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 经济学框架：基于消费者福利和经济效益的分析
2. 组织理论：关注管理者决策过程和商业实践实施
3. 合同法理论：特别是长期关系性合同理论
4. 综合框架：整合上述三个学科的理论贡献
AI.method: 理论综合与框架构建方法：将合同法理论、经济学和组织理论的贡献整合成一个通用的理论框架，然后将该框架应用于纵向限制的具体反垄断问题分析。
AI.findings:
1. 纵向限制本质上是可能通过部分抑制市场力量来增强经济效益的通用商业实践
2. 组织理论可以提供对商业实践实施决策的明确实用解释
3. 经济学和组织理论都可以用于分析长期合同类型的纵向限制
4. 通过扩展传统合同法分析来整合经济学和组织理论方法是可行的
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了一个整合经济学、组织理论和合同法理论的综合性分析框架
2. 将纵向限制重新概念化为可能增强经济效益的通用商业实践
3. 为反垄断分析提供了超越单纯经济学视角的多学科工具
4. 强调了在较低抽象层次（企业内部）分析纵向限制的重要性
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为反垄断政策制定提供了更全面的分析工具
2. 建议对纵向限制采取强有力但可反驳的合法性推定
3. 为法院和监管机构提供了更实用的商业实践分析框架
4. 有助于制定更连贯、可操作的纵向限制反垄断政策

title: Patent Quality Versus Quantity in the Intangible Economy: A Cross-Industry Empirical Analysis of Innovation-Driven Market Valuation
affiliations: University of Liège - HEC-Liège, Management School of the University of Liège

detail.title: Patent Quality Versus Quantity in the Intangible Economy: A Cross-Industry Empirical Analysis of Innovation-Driven Market Valuation
detail.abstract: This study examines how patent portfolios relate to market capitalization in an economy where intangible assets account for roughly 90% of corporate value. Using a 10-year panel (2015-2024) of 40 public firms across technology, pharmaceutical, and consumer sectors, I estimate OLS, firm fixed-effects, and generalized estimating equation models within the Hall-Jaffe-Trajtenberg valuation framework to test whether citation-weighted patent quality outperforms raw patent quantity as a predictor of market value. Results show that citation elasticity (β₃ = 0.26-0.31, p < 0.01) is approximately 2-3× larger than the elasticity of patent productivity (β₂ = 0.06-0.12), indicating that patent quality is substantially more informative for valuation than simple counts. Technical founder-CEOs sustain about 22% higher R&D intensity and exhibit a positive interaction with citation quality, while geographic filing breadth serves as a cost-effective quality proxy: only 3.3% of Chinese patents are filed internationally versus more than 70% for advanced economies. Sector heterogeneity is pronounced, with the patent-value relationship strongest in pharmaceuticals (ρ ≈ 0.71), moderate in semiconductors, and weak and often statistically insignificant in consumer goods. Case studies of NVIDIA's decade-long CUDA investment, Intel's forgone AI platform bets, and a projected 2025-2030 pharmaceutical "patent cliff" illustrate the mechanisms by which technical leadership and AI-enabled drug discovery reshape the economic returns to patents. The findings imply that conventional patent metrics systematically mismeasure innovation value and suggest that investors, corporate strategists, and policy makers should overweight citation velocity and geographic breadth-rather than raw counts-when evaluating innovation-driven market value.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现在无形资产占企业价值90%的经济中，专利质量（以引用加权衡量）比专利数量更能预测市值，技术创始人CEO能维持更高研发强度，地理申请广度是有效的质量代理指标，且专利价值关系在不同行业差异显著。
AI.research_question: 在无形资产占企业价值约90%的经济中，专利组合如何与市值相关？特别是，引用加权的专利质量是否比原始专利数量更能预测市场价值？
AI.motivation: 无形资产在现代经济中占据主导地位（约占企业价值的90%），但传统专利指标可能无法准确衡量创新价值，需要更精细的指标来评估专利组合对市值的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: Hall-Jaffe-Trajtenberg估值框架，该框架用于分析专利价值与市场价值的关系。
AI.method: 使用2015-2024年10年面板数据，涵盖技术、制药和消费品行业的40家上市公司，采用OLS、企业固定效应和广义估计方程模型进行估计。
AI.findings: 1. 引用弹性（β₃ = 0.26-0.31）比专利生产率弹性（β₂ = 0.06-0.12）大2-3倍，表明专利质量比简单数量更能预测价值；2. 技术创始人CEO能维持约22%更高的研发强度，并与引用质量有正向交互作用；3. 地理申请广度是成本效益高的质量代理指标；4. 行业异质性显著，制药行业专利价值关系最强（ρ ≈ 0.71），半导体行业中等，消费品行业弱且统计不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了Hall-Jaffe-Trajtenberg估值框架，强调了专利质量相对于数量的重要性；2. 揭示了技术领导力（技术创始人CEO）对专利价值创造的影响机制；3. 提出了地理申请广度作为专利质量的代理指标；4. 识别了专利价值关系的行业异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者、企业战略制定者和政策制定者提供了更准确的专利评估指标（引用速度和地理广度而非原始数量）；2. 帮助企业识别技术领导力对创新回报的影响；3. 为不同行业提供了差异化的专利价值评估方法；4. 通过案例研究（NVIDIA、Intel、制药专利悬崖）展示了专利价值创造的实际机制。

title: Priority Access for Ecosystem Seeding
affiliations: Zhongnan University of Economics and Law - School of Finance,  and University of Southern California Gould School of Law

detail.title: Priority Access for Ecosystem Seeding
detail.abstract: Leading technology providers often adopt ecosystem seeding-cultivating promising partners before commercial potential is fully realized-as a strategy to sustain dominance. Yet supply constraints-such as limited capacity in advanced semiconductor manufacturing-limit their ability to serve all potential customers (e.g., AI startups) and fully unleash the value of their technology edge. Programs such as Nvidia's Inception illustrate one response: engaging a broad pool of potential buyers and prioritizing access to scarce resources. This paper examines how such priority access mechanisms can better enable ecosystem seeding and improve long-run firm value and how they shape competition, supply-chain outcomes, and technological innovation. We study a two-period supply chain in which an incumbent sellers interacts with rival suppliers and forward-looking buyers under endogenous pricing and technology development decisions. The incumbent could grant priority access to selective buyers based on its assessment of buyers' prospect. Relative to price-based allocation, priority access is most valuable to the incumbent when the supply constraint is severe or when buyer switching costs are high. Surprisingly, the value of priority access does not necessarily increase with the incumbent's assessment quality. While priority access primarily benefits the incumbent, it can also raise rival profitability, improve supply-chain efficiency, and accelerate technology development. These benefits can be further enhanced through strategic information disclosure and multi-tiered prioritization. Our analysis reveals when priority access can serve as an effective strategic lever for supply-constrained technology leaders. They also inform debates about the competitive effects of such programs by highlighting conditions under which access prioritization generates positive spillovers beyond the incumbent. Finally, the findings offers practical guidance on the design and operationalization of priority access mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究供应受限的技术领导者如何通过优先访问机制（如Nvidia的Inception计划）进行生态系统培育，分析其对长期企业价值、竞争、供应链结果和技术创新的影响。
AI.research_question: 供应受限的技术领导者如何通过优先访问机制更好地进行生态系统培育，并提高长期企业价值？这种机制如何影响竞争、供应链结果和技术创新？
AI.motivation: 领先技术提供商常采用生态系统培育策略来维持主导地位，但供应约束（如先进半导体制造能力有限）限制了服务所有潜在客户的能力。需要研究如何通过优先访问机制（如Nvidia的Inception计划）来优化资源配置。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于供应链管理、生态系统理论和战略资源分配理论，研究在供应约束下技术领导者如何通过优先访问机制进行生态系统培育。
AI.method: 采用两期供应链模型，分析在位卖方与竞争对手供应商、前瞻性买家之间的互动，考虑内生定价和技术开发决策，研究优先访问机制的效果。
AI.findings: 1. 相对于基于价格的分配，优先访问在供应约束严重或买家转换成本高时对在位者最有价值；2. 优先访问的价值不一定随评估质量提高而增加；3. 优先访问主要使在位者受益，但也能提高竞争对手盈利能力、改善供应链效率并加速技术发展；4. 战略信息披露和多层次优先级可进一步增强这些效益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了优先访问机制作为供应受限技术领导者战略杠杆的有效条件；2. 阐明了优先访问产生超越在位者正外部性的条件；3. 丰富了生态系统培育和资源分配理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为技术领导者设计优先访问机制提供实践指导；2. 为政策制定者评估此类计划的竞争效应提供依据；3. 帮助企业理解在供应约束下如何优化生态系统培育策略。

title: Complexity Creep
affiliations: Indiana University Maurer School of Law (Bloomington)

detail.title: Complexity Creep
detail.abstract:
We use software to save time, and then we spend that time managing the software. This Article names the pattern: complexity creep – the gradual proliferation of features, options, updates, and incompatibilities that transforms functional software tools into drains on time and productivity. No one sets out to create it; complexity creep emerges from market forces and competitive dynamics that reward accumulation over efficiency.

The Article makes three contributions. Empirically, it presents the first systematic estimate of the costs of complexity creep, synthesizing industry surveys, government data, and natural experiments. Digital friction costs American workers roughly five to seven hours per week, amounting to hundreds of billions – likely over one trillion – dollars annually in lost time. This burden falls disproportionately on older workers and those with lower digital literacy, functioning as a regressive tax on time.

Conceptually, the Article frames complexity creep as a form of digital pollution: firms impose time costs they do not bear, users cannot evaluate complexity before purchase or escape it afterward, and markets reward feature accumulation rather than correcting for it. This is a classic externality – and like environmental pollution before the Clean Air Act, it will not self-correct. Legally, the Article demonstrates why contract, tort, consumer protection, and antitrust frameworks each fail to address it. Drawing on environmental law’s evolution from nuisance to statutory regulation, the Article develops a regulatory toolkit designed to internalize time costs. The toolkit includes complexity disclosures, symmetry requirements, impact statements, and interoperability mandates.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统估计了"复杂性蔓延"的成本，发现数字摩擦每周消耗美国工人5-7小时，年损失达数千亿美元。文章将复杂性蔓延概念化为数字污染，并基于环境法演变提出监管工具包。
AI.research_question: 复杂性蔓延（软件功能、选项、更新和不兼容性的逐渐扩散）如何影响生产力和时间成本？现有法律框架为何无法解决这一问题？应如何设计监管工具来内部化这些时间成本？
AI.motivation: 软件本应节省时间，但用户却花费大量时间管理软件本身。这种"复杂性蔓延"现象源于市场力量和竞争动态，但缺乏系统性研究和有效监管解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 复杂性蔓延作为数字污染（digital pollution）概念框架；2. 外部性理论（负外部性）；3. 环境法从妨害到法定监管的演变理论；4. 市场失灵理论。
AI.method: 实证研究：综合行业调查、政府数据和自然实验，首次系统估计复杂性蔓延的成本。概念分析：将复杂性蔓延框架化为数字污染。法律分析：评估合同、侵权、消费者保护和反垄断框架的局限性。
AI.findings: 1. 数字摩擦每周消耗美国工人5-7小时，年损失达数千亿至超万亿美元；2. 负担不成比例地落在年长工人和数字素养较低者身上，形成时间上的累退税；3. 现有法律框架均无法有效解决复杂性蔓延问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"复杂性蔓延"作为系统性概念；2. 建立"数字污染"理论框架，将软件复杂性类比为环境外部性；3. 将环境法理论应用于数字监管领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供复杂性蔓延成本的首次系统估计；2. 提出监管工具包：复杂性披露、对称性要求、影响声明和互操作性授权；3. 为政策制定者提供基于环境法演变的监管设计思路。

title: The Role of Advanced Technologies in Corporate Decarbonization: A Problematizing Review and Comparative Research Agenda
affiliations: LUT University, Durham University Business School and LUT University

detail.title: The Role of Advanced Technologies in Corporate Decarbonization: A Problematizing Review and Comparative Research Agenda

declarations.funderStatement: The research was supported by the Society for the Advancement of Management Studies through the British Academy/Leverhulme Small Research Grants Scheme, Grant reference number SRG2223\231623

publicationDetails.detailsText: Montero-Teran, H. N., Sinkovics, R. R., & Kuivalainen, O. (2025). The role of advanced technologies in corporate decarbonization: A problematizing review and comparative research agenda. Management International Review, accepted for publication and forthcoming

detail.abstract: Advanced technologies are widely promoted as tools for decarbonization across sectors such as manufacturing, logistics, and energy. However, evidence of their environmental impact remains mixed, with outcomes varying significantly between settings. This variability highlights the need to understand how national institutional contexts shape the implementation and effectiveness of these technologies. A comparative international business perspective is especially useful in uncovering why the same technology leads to different results between countries, revealing the role of regulatory environments, market dynamics, and organizational norms. This paper uses a problematizing review method to critically examine five types of assumptions found in current research: in-house, root metaphor, paradigm, ideology, and field assumptions. This paper analyzes these assumptions through diagnostic, prognostic, and motivational framings. The data for this review was drawn from a systematic search of the Web of Science and Scopus databases, supplemented by manual searches of high-ranking journals across multiple disciplines, resulting in a final sample of 64 relevant peer-reviewed articles. Our contribution includes exposing blind spots in existing literature, proposing a future research agenda, and encouraging a more contextsensitive, institutionally informed approach to technology and decarbonization in comparative international business.

AI.tldr: 该论文采用问题化综述方法，批判性地检视了当前研究中关于先进技术对脱碳影响的五种假设类型，揭示了国家制度背景如何塑造技术实施效果，并提出了更具情境敏感性的研究议程。
AI.research_question: 国家制度背景如何塑造先进技术在脱碳过程中的实施和有效性？为什么相同的技术在不同国家会产生不同的环境结果？
AI.motivation: 先进技术被广泛推广为制造业、物流和能源等领域的脱碳工具，但其环境影响证据不一，结果在不同情境下差异显著。这种差异性凸显了理解国家制度背景如何塑造这些技术的实施和有效性的必要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较国际商务视角，关注制度理论（监管环境、市场动态、组织规范），以及问题化综述方法中的诊断、预后和动机框架。
AI.method: 问题化综述方法，系统检索Web of Science和Scopus数据库，辅以对多学科高排名期刊的手动检索，最终样本包含64篇相关同行评审文章。
AI.findings: 通过批判性检视五种假设类型（内部假设、根隐喻假设、范式假设、意识形态假设、领域假设），揭示了当前研究中的盲点，强调了制度背景对技术脱碳效果的关键调节作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 暴露现有文献中的盲点，提出未来研究议程，推动比较国际商务领域对技术与脱碳关系采取更具情境敏感性、制度意识的研究方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 鼓励政策制定者和企业在推广脱碳技术时更加关注国家特定的制度环境，避免一刀切的技术解决方案，促进更有效的技术实施策略。

title: The SPIRIT of Science: Institutional Responses to the P-Hacking Problem in Academic Clinical Trials
affiliations: Columbia University - Columbia Business School,  and Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Management

detail.title: The SPIRIT of Science: Institutional Responses to the P-Hacking Problem in Academic Clinical Trials

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: All researchers face pressure to demonstrate significance, but whether that pressure distorts findings may depend on how observable their analytic choices are. We examine this in clinical trials, where academic and industry sponsors face similar evidentiary benchmarks but differ in documentation practices and oversight contexts. Using p-value distributions from 10,596 completed randomized clinical trials registered on ClinicalTrials.gov, we test for threshold-driven distortions around p = 0.05. Academicsponsored trials exhibit an excess of primary-outcome p-values just below 0.05, while industry-sponsored trials show little or no such pattern; secondary outcomes show no comparable distortion for either sponsor type. Internal consistency checks between reported p-values and 95% confidence intervals replicate the same sponsor gap, and a validation exercise using p-values extracted from PubMed Central trial publications yields similar directional differences. The academic-industry gap persists after adjusting for trial characteristics, suggesting that organizational setting itself may matter. We examine the 2013 SPIRIT statement (Standard Protocol Items: Recommendations for Interventional Trials), which standardized protocol documentation for clinical trials. Academic trials initiated after SPIRIT show weaker evidence of threshold-adjacent bunching than those initiated earlier, whereas trials initiated earlier but reported later show no comparable change-a pattern suggestive of protocol design and documentation as a relevant margin.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究了学术和产业赞助的临床试验中p值分布差异，发现学术赞助的试验在p=0.05阈值附近存在明显的堆积现象，而产业赞助的试验则没有这种模式，这种差异可能与组织环境和研究透明度有关。
AI.research_question: 学术赞助和产业赞助的临床试验在统计显著性阈值（p=0.05）附近是否存在不同的p值分布模式？这种差异是否与组织环境和研究透明度有关？
AI.motivation: 所有研究人员都面临证明研究显著性的压力，但这种压力是否会扭曲研究发现，可能取决于分析选择的可观察性。临床试验领域提供了一个理想的自然实验环境，因为学术和产业赞助者面临相似的证据标准，但在文档实践和监督环境上存在差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于研究透明度、组织环境和研究实践的理论框架，探讨不同赞助类型（学术vs产业）如何影响研究结果的报告行为，特别是在统计显著性阈值附近的选择性报告或p-hacking现象。
AI.method: 使用ClinicalTrials.gov上注册的10,596个已完成随机临床试验的p值分布进行分析，检验p=0.05阈值附近的扭曲现象。通过内部一致性检查（比较报告的p值和95%置信区间）进行验证，并使用PubMed Central试验出版物中提取的p值进行验证性分析。还考察了2013年SPIRIT声明对协议文档标准化的影响。
AI.findings: 学术赞助的试验在主要结局的p值分布中显示出在p=0.05阈值以下的过度堆积，而产业赞助的试验几乎没有这种模式；次要结局中两种赞助类型都没有可比性的扭曲。学术-产业差距在调整试验特征后仍然存在。2013年SPIRIT声明实施后，学术试验的阈值附近堆积现象减弱，表明协议设计和文档是相关的影响因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于揭示了组织环境对研究实践的影响，表明研究透明度（通过协议文档标准化）可以减少选择性报告行为。提出了"可观察性"作为调节研究压力对结果扭曲影响的关键因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：1）为临床试验监管提供证据，支持协议预注册和文档标准化的重要性；2）为学术机构改进研究实践提供指导；3）为期刊编辑和同行评审提供识别潜在p-hacking的工具；4）支持SPIRIT等标准化倡议的有效性。

title: Deafening Silence: NASW Restructuring and the Fear of Speaking Up

detail.title: Deafening Silence: NASW Restructuring and the Fear of Speaking Up

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests. The author is the founder of The Macro Lens LLC, a social enterprise focused on macro social work education and practice. The author previously served as the MSW Student Representative on the NASW Iowa Chapter Board. This prior role and current professional affiliation did not influence the design, analysis, interpretation, or reporting of the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human subjects research as defined by institutional review board (IRB) standards. The analysis draws on publicly available documents, published literature, and thematic patterns observed in unsolicited professional feedback provided in response to the author’s previously published work. No participants were recruited, no identifiable data were collected or reported, and no direct quotations are attributed to individuals. Accordingly, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
This paper examines the November 2025 restructuring of the National Association of Social Workers (NASW) through the lens of organizational silence and governance accountability. The analysis documents a systematic pattern in which social workers who witnessed or experienced concerning institutional practices felt unable to speak publicly due to fear of professional retaliation. Drawing on direct communications with former staff, chapter leaders, and current members, the paper reveals how silence itself becomes evidence of power dynamics that contradict core social work values.

The restructuring eliminated fourteen state chapter executive director positions and consolidated governance authority at the national level. Financial analysis of IRS Form 990 filings demonstrates that this decision was not driven by fiscal emergency. Membership dues remained stable from 2021-2024, and the organization showed positive net income in three of the past four fiscal years. This reframes the restructuring as a governance choice rather than a financial necessity.

At least seven state chapters have taken formal institutional action challenging national leadership decisions, including votes of no confidence from Iowa, Texas, and Michigan chapters. These actions cite concerns about transparency, participatory decision-making, and adherence to the profession's Code of Ethics. The paper situates these governance failures within the broader phenomenon of clinical drift, arguing that centralized organizational structures mirror the profession's systematic retreat from macro practice and systems change.

The analysis reveals critical tensions between NASW's role as teacher of ethical practice and its own organizational behavior. When a professional association that trains social workers in transparency, accountability, and speaking truth to power operates through opacity and discourages dissent, it undermines the moral authority of the entire profession. The paper concludes with recommendations for governance reform grounded in social work's foundational commitment to participatory democracy and ethical stewardship.

AI.tldr: 本文通过组织沉默和治理问责视角分析NASW 2025年重组，揭示社会工作者因害怕报复而不敢发声的系统性模式，指出重组是治理选择而非财务必需，并探讨专业协会行为与伦理价值观的冲突。
AI.research_question: NASW 2025年重组如何体现组织沉默和治理问责问题，以及这些治理失败如何影响社会工作专业的道德权威？
AI.motivation: 分析专业协会内部治理实践与其教授的核心社会工作价值观之间的冲突，揭示组织沉默如何成为权力动态的证据，并探讨治理改革的需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织沉默理论、治理问责理论、临床漂移理论、社会工作伦理价值观（透明度、参与式决策、伦理实践）
AI.method: 定性分析：与前任员工、分会领导、现任成员直接沟通；财务分析：IRS Form 990文件分析；制度行动分析：至少七个州分会的正式挑战行动
AI.findings: 1. 社会工作者因害怕专业报复而不敢公开表达关切；2. 重组是治理选择而非财务必需（会费稳定，多数年份净收入为正）；3. 多个州分会采取正式行动挑战全国领导层决策；4. NASW作为伦理实践教师与其自身组织行为存在关键张力
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将组织沉默理论应用于专业协会治理分析；2. 扩展临床漂移理论到组织层面；3. 揭示专业协会伦理教学与组织实践之间的理论张力
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供基于参与式民主和伦理管理的治理改革建议；2. 为专业协会如何践行其教授的价值观提供实践指导；3. 增强社会工作专业对治理问责重要性的认识

title: Structural Analysis of Assembly Systems with Component Demand and Capacity Constraints
affiliations: Shanghai University of Finance and Economics - College of Business and University of British Columbia

detail.title: Structural Analysis of Assembly Systems with Component Demand and Capacity Constraints
detail.abstract: We study a multi-stage assembly inventory system in which demands arise for components in addition to the assembled product. Production at each stage is constrained by capacity. These features violate the inventory balance conditions that underpin classic decomposition-based analyses of assembly systems, rendering existing structural results inapplicable. We introduce an equivalent reformulation that converts component backlogging into a lost-sales representation, which induces a monotone ordering structure on echelon inventories. Our main theoretical result establishes that the dynamic cost-to-go functions of the reformulated system are $L^\natural$-convex. This discrete convexity property implies convexity and submodularity and yields economically meaningful monotone optimal policies and bounded sensitivity of decisions across stages. In particular, optimal ordering, assembly, and component allocation decisions are monotone in echelon inventory states and adjust in a structured manner in response to inventory perturbations. These results provide new structural insights for assembly systems with dual-use components and capacity limitations, extending classic assembly theory beyond balanced inventory regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个多阶段装配库存系统，其中除了最终产品外，组件也有需求。每个阶段的生产都受产能限制。这些特征违反了经典装配系统分解分析所依赖的库存平衡条件。作者引入了一种等效重构方法，将组件缺货转换为缺货损失表示，从而在层级库存上诱导出单调排序结构。主要理论结果表明，重构系统的动态成本函数具有L♮-凸性，这保证了最优策略的单调性和决策的敏感性有界。
AI.research_question: 在多阶段装配库存系统中，当组件和最终产品都有需求且生产受产能限制时，如何分析系统的最优库存控制策略？
AI.motivation: 传统装配系统的分解分析依赖于库存平衡条件，但当组件也有独立需求且生产受产能限制时，这些条件被违反，现有结构结果不再适用。需要新的理论框架来分析这类更复杂的装配系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 装配系统理论、库存控制理论、离散凸分析（L♮-凸性）、动态规划、单调比较理论
AI.method: 引入等效重构方法，将组件缺货转换为缺货损失表示，建立单调排序结构，证明动态成本函数的L♮-凸性，推导最优策略的结构性质
AI.findings: 重构系统的动态成本函数具有L♮-凸性，这意味着凸性和次模性。最优订购、装配和组件分配决策在层级库存状态下是单调的，并且对库存扰动以结构化方式调整。这些结果为具有双重用途组件和产能限制的装配系统提供了新的结构洞察。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将组件缺货转换为缺货损失表示的等效重构方法；2）证明了动态成本函数的L♮-凸性；3）扩展了经典装配理论，超越了平衡库存机制；4）为具有双重用途组件和产能限制的装配系统提供了新的结构洞察
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供了分析复杂装配系统的理论工具；2）揭示了最优策略的单调性质，有助于简化决策制定；3）证明了决策的敏感性有界，增强了系统的鲁棒性；4）为实际装配系统的库存控制提供了理论指导

title: Balancing Occupational Health, Economy and Environment in Abandoned Industrial Building Reconstruction: A Multi-objective Optimization Perspective
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Beijing University of Civil Engineering and Architecture

detail.title: Balancing Occupational Health, Economy and Environment in Abandoned Industrial Building Reconstruction: A Multi-objective Optimization Perspective
detail.abstract: Adaptive reuse of abandoned industrial buildings is increasingly recognized as a strategic pathway for reducing lifecycle carbon emissions and supporting low-carbon urban energy transitions. However, renovation activities are often characterized by pronounced trade-offs among occupational health protection, economic feasibility, and environmental performance, particularly under conditions of confined spaces, residual pollutants, and high workforce density. Existing sustainability-oriented decision frameworks rarely quantify these interdependencies within a unified, scalable optimization structure. This study develops a transferable multi-objective decision framework to support low-carbon renovation planning for abandoned industrial buildings by simultaneously minimizing occupational health risk (H), project cost (C), and carbon emissions (E). A hierarchical evaluation system is established in which workforce density and pollutant diffusion are explicitly incorporated as key determinants of health risk. A constrained multi-objective optimization model is formulated subject to resource availability, workforce safety thresholds, and pollutant diffusion control. The Pareto-optimal solution space is explored using NSGA-III, and a comprehensive optimal solution is identified through the Entropy - TOPSIS method. The case study indicates that the proposed framework achieves balanced system-level improvements, reducing H, C, and E by 1.1%, 2.3%, and 5.1%, respectively, relative to the baseline scenario. Extreme single-objective solutions expose substantial trade-offs: a 1.6% reduction in occupational health risk results in increases of 19.8% in cost and 14.9% in carbon emissions, whereas low-cost and low-emission strategies lead to a 1.4–1.7% increase in health risk. The proposed framework provides quantitative evidence to support sustainability-oriented policy design, investment prioritization, and large-scale deployment of low-carbon regeneration strategies for industrial building stock.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个可转移的多目标决策框架，用于支持废弃工业建筑的低碳改造规划，同时最小化职业健康风险、项目成本和碳排放。通过案例研究表明，该框架能实现系统层面的平衡改进，相比基准情景分别减少1.1%、2.3%和5.1%。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个可转移的多目标决策框架，在废弃工业建筑改造中同时优化职业健康风险、项目成本和碳排放？
AI.motivation: 废弃工业建筑改造在减少生命周期碳排放和支持低碳城市能源转型方面具有战略意义，但现有改造活动在职业健康保护、经济可行性和环境绩效之间存在显著权衡，现有可持续性决策框架很少在统一、可扩展的优化结构中量化这些相互依赖关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多目标优化理论、职业健康风险评估理论、生命周期碳排放评估理论、帕累托最优理论
AI.method: 建立分层评估系统，将劳动力密度和污染物扩散作为健康风险的关键决定因素；构建受资源可用性、劳动力安全阈值和污染物扩散控制约束的多目标优化模型；使用NSGA-III探索帕累托最优解空间；通过熵权-TOPSIS方法确定综合最优解；进行案例研究验证。
AI.findings: 提出的框架实现了系统层面的平衡改进，相比基准情景分别减少职业健康风险1.1%、成本2.3%和碳排放5.1%。极端单目标解决方案显示出显著权衡：职业健康风险降低1.6%会导致成本增加19.8%和碳排放增加14.9%，而低成本低排放策略会导致健康风险增加1.4-1.7%。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了一个可转移的多目标决策框架，首次在统一优化结构中量化了废弃工业建筑改造中职业健康风险、成本和碳排放之间的相互依赖关系；建立了包含劳动力密度和污染物扩散的分层健康风险评估系统。
AI.practical_contributions: 为可持续性政策设计、投资优先级确定和工业建筑存量大规模低碳再生策略部署提供了定量证据支持；帮助决策者在职业健康保护、经济可行性和环境绩效之间做出平衡决策。

title: How Legal and Dispute Resolution Professionals Can Manage AI Risks
affiliations: University of Missouri School of Law

detail.title: How Legal and Dispute Resolution Professionals Can Manage AI Risks

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Missouri School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2026-10
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Missouri School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: 44 Alternatives to the High Cost of Litigation (2026)

detail.abstract:
Legal and dispute resolution professionals are increasingly using generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools to enhance their work and increase efficiency.  These tools can provide valuable assistance in research, drafting, and brainstorming, but they also carry serious risks.  This article identifies three categories of AI-related risk that are especially relevant to legal and dispute resolution practice:  breaches of confidentiality, factual inaccuracies, and sycophantic reasoning.

It outlines relevant ethical duties for lawyers, mediators, and arbitrators, and provides practical strategies to manage the risks effectively.  The article categorizes common tasks by risk level and offers guidance on matching appropriate safeguards to each level.

Professionals can use AI responsibly – protecting their clients, integrity, and reputations – by understanding these risks and adopting sound practices.  The article also urges professionals to apply consistent standards across platforms including by highlighting how AI privacy concerns compare to those of other common digital tools.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨法律与争议解决专业人士使用生成式AI工具的风险管理，识别三类主要风险（保密性破坏、事实不准确、奉承性推理），提出基于风险等级的任务分类和相应保障措施，帮助专业人士负责任地使用AI。
AI.research_question: 法律与争议解决专业人士如何在使用生成式AI工具时有效管理相关风险，同时遵守职业道德义务？
AI.motivation: 随着法律和争议解决专业人士越来越多地使用生成式AI工具来提高工作效率，这些工具虽然能提供研究、起草和头脑风暴方面的帮助，但也带来了严重的风险。需要识别这些风险并提供有效的管理策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于法律职业道德理论、风险管理理论和AI伦理框架，结合法律实践中的保密义务、准确性要求和职业独立性原则。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，包括：1）识别三类AI相关风险；2）分析律师、调解员和仲裁员的相关道德义务；3）按风险等级对常见任务进行分类；4）提出与每个风险等级相匹配的保障措施。
AI.findings: 识别出三类主要风险：保密性破坏、事实不准确、奉承性推理。提出了基于风险等级的任务分类方法，并提供了相应的风险管理策略。强调需要跨平台应用一致的标准，并将AI隐私问题与其他数字工具进行比较。

title: Supporting the Adoption of Research Partnerships in Spinal Cord Injury Research: An exploratory case study of a research centre
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of British Columbia Okanagan, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of British Columbia Okanagan, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Supporting the Adoption of Research Partnerships in Spinal Cord Injury Research: An exploratory case study of a research centre
detail.abstract: BackgroundResearch coproduction may help to enhance the relevance, usefulness, and application of spinal cord injury (SCI) research. The Integrated Knowledge Translation (IKT) Guiding Principles were developed to support meaningful SCI research partnerships, yet limited evidence exists on how research institutions can support their adoption.PurposeThis study aimed to explore how coproduction is practiced and supported within a SCI research centre and to identify strategies for fostering principles-based research coproduction.MethodsThis exploratory retrospective case study was conducted at ICORD, a multidisciplinary SCI research centre located in Vancouver, British Columbia. Data sources included ten years of internal grant applications, a network analysis of research collaborations, and surveys and interviews with researchers, trainees, and partners. Grant applications were coded to assess coproduction characteristics and analyzed using descriptive statistics. Interviews and surveys were analyzed using the Theoretical Domains Framework and Behaviour Change Wheel to identify barriers, facilitators, and potential intervention strategies.ResultsOf the 160 internal grant applications, 28.8% included non-academic partners, and those projects were significantly less likely to be funded (p<0.001, Cramér’s V=0.278). Network analysis showed collaborations were largely siloed within academia. Survey and interview participants were interested in coproduction but cited limited skills, institutional support, and unclear expectations as barriers. Supportive leadership, mentorship, and visible examples were seen as key enablers. Across methods, participants called for capacity building, clearer guidance, dedicated funding, and changes to review processes to better support and value research partnerships.ConclusionsThis study provides a theory-informed analysis of coproduction within an academic research centre. Findings suggest that research institutions can play a critical role in enabling coproduction by embedding supportive structures, processes, and cultural shifts. These insights can inform efforts to advance more inclusive and impactful SCI research.

title: Employees' Self-Management Competency Level: Its Impact on Managerial Functions
affiliations: Gulf College and Palfish Company, Ltd.,

detail.title: Employees' Self-Management Competency Level: Its Impact on Managerial Functions
detail.abstract: Self-management abilities are traits that make a worker feel more at ease and effective at work. This paper aims to investigate two pivotal parameters related to self-management. Firstly, it determines which of the identified six-skill attributes of self-management are commonly recognised by the participants to have a low or high level of competency. Secondly, it explores the impact of the revealed skill on managerial functions. The tool utilised in gathering the data was structured and closed-ended in form. The participants of the study are male and female students who are officially registered at one of the colleges in Oman. Specifically, the selected participants are classified as working students. The weighted mean formula was employed to achieve the answers to the set problems in this paper. The study found that trustworthiness is the skill that was exhibited by the participants with the lowest level of competency in terms of selfmanagement. Meanwhile, they declared that conscientiousness is the skill in which they have the highest level of self-management competency.

detail.abstract:
This independent forensic assessment analyzes the operational resilience of Armenia’s banking and public administration sectors. Based on a forensic review of 38,517 timestamped interactions and 2,643 verified failure events, the audit identifies a systemic "Implementation Gap" between legislative commitments and operational reality. Key findings include an estimated $121–184 million USD excess cost burden on residents, documentation of "Shadow Regulation" (V.A.R.), and critical infrastructure failures (unencrypted biometric data). The report serves as a procedural trigger for regulatory review by EU OLAF and World Bank INT

detail.abstract: We find that a firm’s social network size improves its information environment quality, consistent with social capital theory that networks enable valuable information flow, trust, and truthful sharing. This effect is more pronounced for complex firms with diverse customers, regulations, and coordination issues. Firm social network size also positively affects firm value, mediated by enhanced information quality. The study employs multiple linear regression, Heckman two-step selection, propensity score matching, entropy balancing, and two-stage least squares methods.

title: The Board's Education Through Compliance Consultants
affiliations: Duke University School of Law

detail.title: The Board's Education Through Compliance Consultants

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Corporate Governance Institute - Law Working Paper No. 899/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) - Law Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Organizations today face increasing expectations to ensure the effectiveness of their compliance programs. Regulatory guidance, including the Department of Justice’s Evaluation of Corporate Compliance Programs, emphasizes not only the existence of compliance structures but their ongoing effectiveness in preventing, detecting, and responding to misconduct. These expectations place boards of directors at the center of compliance oversight, even where boards may lack the expertise or information necessary to assess whether internal systems are functioning as intended. In response, organizations have turned to a growing market of outside compliance consultants to assist boards in evaluating speak-up mechanisms, investigation processes, compliance culture, and program design. These engagements can include program assessments, interviews, cultural audits, climate surveys, and other evaluative tools, and they increasingly intersect with complex regulatory environments and emerging technologies that further complicate compliance oversight. As boards navigate these requirements, they face consequential choices about when to engage outside consultants and which types of consultants to retain—choices that are often treated as routine but in fact carry significant governance implications.

This Article argues that boards must take seriously their responsibility to secure appropriate education for compliance oversight — a duty that often requires not just retaining outside consultants, but deliberately structuring, constraining, and governing those engagements so that the education boards receive is candid, independent, and aligned with the firm’s purpose and fiduciary commitments. The Article examines how differences in consultants’ constraints, incentives, and institutional positions may affect the education boards receive. Professional norms may help channel consultant behavior, but they are neither universal nor sufficient. Where consultants lack formal professional obligations, boards may bear greater responsibility for structuring engagements around clearly articulated, measurable standards rooted in the firm’s purpose, ethical commitments, and risk profile, and for defining expectations of candor, independence, and escalation. Ultimately, the question is not whether boards should engage compliance consultants to assist them—that is largely a foregone conclusion—but how boards can structure those engagements to ensure they are meaningfully educated for the oversight role they retain.

title: The Nomination Peace Prize 2026 National Insight and State Defense within the Framework of Bhinneka Tunggal Ika
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Nomination Peace Prize 2026 National Insight and State Defense within the Framework of Bhinneka Tunggal Ika
detail.abstract: Indonesia is the world's largest archipelagic state, characterized by a high degree of geographical, demographic, and cultural diversity, encompassing hundreds of ethnic groups, rich cultural traditions and customary practices, a wide range of local languages, and abundant natural resources. This diversity constitutes both a national asset and a challenge in maintaining the unity and integrity of the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia (NKRI). This article aims to examine the landscape of Indonesia's diversity and national wealth and to analyze the roles of Bhinneka Tunggal Ika, National Insight (Wawasan Kebangsaan), and State Defense (Bela Negara) as strategic instruments for managing national pluralism. The study employs a conceptual-analytical approach based on official state sources and relevant literature on nationhood. The discussion demonstrates that Bhinneka Tunggal Ika functions as a unifying value principle, National Insight serves as a framework for national integration, and State Defense represents the practical actualization of these principles in social, cultural, economic, and civic life. The synergy among these three elements constitutes a fundamental prerequisite for strengthening national resilience, safeguarding territorial integrity, and ensuring that diversity remains an integrative force for Indonesia amid the dynamics of global change.

AI.research_question: 印度尼西亚的多样性和国家财富如何通过"殊途同归"、国家洞察力和国家防卫等战略工具来管理，以维护国家统一和完整？
AI.motivation: 印度尼西亚作为世界上最大的群岛国家，具有高度的地理、人口和文化多样性，这种多样性既是国家资产，也对维护印度尼西亚共和国统一国家的完整构成挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国家统一理论、多元文化管理理论和国家韧性理论，重点分析"殊途同归"（Bhinneka Tunggal Ika）、国家洞察力（Wawasan Kebangsaan）和国家防卫（Bela Negara）的概念框架。
AI.method: 采用概念分析方法，基于官方国家资料和相关的国家建设文献进行研究。
AI.findings: 研究发现："殊途同归"作为统一的价值原则发挥作用；国家洞察力作为国家整合的框架；国家防卫则是这些原则在社会、文化、经济和公民生活中的实际体现。这三者的协同作用是加强国家韧性、维护领土完整和确保多样性成为印度尼西亚在全球变化动态中的整合力量的基本前提。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于提出了一个整合性的框架，将文化多样性管理、国家认同建设和公民防卫实践相结合，为多元社会中的国家统一理论提供了新的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献在于为印度尼西亚政府提供了具体的战略工具组合，用于管理国家多元化，加强国家韧性，并确保多样性成为国家发展的整合力量而非分裂因素。

detail.abstract: The global economic order is undergoing a fundamental transformation as power shifts from a unipolar Western-dominated system toward a multipolar configuration. This research paper examines the emergence of economic multipolarity through three interconnected phenomena: the expansion of BRICS and formation of alternative economic blocs, de-dollarization trends in international finance, and the restructuring of global supply chains. With particular emphasis on India's strategic positioning, this study analyzes how the world's fifth-largest economy navigates this transition through its policy of strategic autonomy and multi-alignment. Drawing on recent data from 2024-2025, including BRICS expansion to ten members representing 37.3% of global GDP and the decline of dollar reserves to 57.3%, this paper employs mixedmethods analysis combining quantitative economic indicators with qualitative policy assessment. The findings reveal that while multipolarity creates opportunities for emerging economies to assert greater influence in global governance, it also introduces complexities including geopolitical tensions, coordination challenges, and the risk of fragmentation. For India, this transition presents a unique opportunity to position itself as a bridge between competing power centers while advancing its economic interests. The research contributes to understanding how middle powers can leverage multipolar dynamics to enhance their global standing without compromising sovereignty. This study concludes that economic multipolarity is not merely a redistribution of power but a fundamental reimagining of how nations collaborate, compete, and coexist in an interconnected world economy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了全球经济秩序从单极西方主导向多极配置转变的过程，重点关注三大现象：金砖国家扩张与替代经济集团形成、国际金融去美元化趋势、全球供应链重组。以印度为例，分析中等强国如何利用多极化提升全球地位。
AI.research_question: 全球经济多极化如何形成？新兴经济体（特别是印度）如何在这种转型中定位自身并提升全球影响力？
AI.motivation: 全球经济秩序正在经历根本性转变，权力从单极西方主导体系向多极配置转移。这一转变对全球治理、国际金融和供应链产生深远影响，需要系统研究新兴经济体如何应对这一历史性变革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际关系理论中的多极化理论、地缘经济学、战略自主理论、多边联盟理论，以及全球治理框架下的权力转移理论。
AI.method: 混合方法分析，结合定量经济指标（如2024-2025年金砖国家占全球GDP 37.3%、美元储备降至57.3%）与定性政策评估。
AI.findings: 多极化为新兴经济体提供了在全球治理中发挥更大影响力的机会，但也带来了地缘政治紧张、协调挑战和碎片化风险。印度通过战略自主和多边结盟政策，成功将自己定位为竞争权力中心之间的桥梁，同时推进自身经济利益。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对经济多极化本质的理解，提出多极化不仅是权力再分配，更是国家在全球经济中合作、竞争和共存方式的根本性重构。为中等强国如何在不损害主权的情况下利用多极化动态提升全球地位提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴经济体（特别是印度）提供了在多极化世界中制定战略的政策建议。帮助政策制定者理解如何平衡不同权力中心的关系，利用多极化机遇，同时管理相关风险。对国际组织和跨国公司调整全球战略具有参考价值。

title:
Characteristic Functions Portfolio Optimization
Multivariate Models, Meta-t Dependence, and Risk Management
affiliations: Artificial Intelligence in Finance Institute

detail.title:
Characteristic Functions Portfolio Optimization
Multivariate Models, Meta-t Dependence, and Risk Management
detail.abstract: We develop a comprehensive framework for modeling multivariate asset return distributions using characteristic functions (CFs). The CF approach offers fundamental advantages over density-based methods: it always exists, uniquely determines the distribution via the Lévy inversion theorem, and admits tractable closed forms for important non-Gaussian models including stable and tempered stable processes. We present eight parametric models-Gaussian, elliptical Student-t, Gaussian mixture, directional stable subordinator, tempered directional stable, low-rank Lévy copula jump factor, Gaussian-Schoenberg composite, and random frequency mixture-with complete mathematical derivations of their characteristic functions. We introduce a meta-t extension formulated directly in characteristic-function space, decoupling marginal behavior from Student-t tail dependence while preserving exact portfolio aggregation. On the statistical side, we develop a weighted L 2 distance metric for model comparison and a factorization defect test for detecting crosssectional dependence, complemented by distance correlation analysis. Empirical analysis of 16 US equities over 2014-2025 demonstrates that the Gaussian mixture model achieves the best fit, while all models exhibit significant cross-block dependence between technology and non-technology sectors. The portfolio projection identity ϕ w ⊤ X (t) = ϕ X (tw) is validated numerically at machine precision. Finally, we establish that law-invariant portfolio optimization problems can be formulated as functional optimization over one-dimensional CF restrictions, with classical meanvariance theory emerging as a second-order truncation of the log-characteristic function.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于特征函数的多元资产收益率分布建模框架，提出了八种参数模型，并建立了模型比较和横截面依赖检测的统计方法。实证分析显示高斯混合模型拟合最佳，所有模型都显示科技与非科技板块间存在显著的跨板块依赖。
AI.research_question: 如何基于特征函数构建多元资产收益率分布的全面建模框架？特征函数方法相比传统密度方法有哪些优势？如何评估不同参数模型的拟合效果和检测横截面依赖？
AI.motivation: 传统基于密度的方法在建模多元资产收益率分布时存在局限性，特别是对于非高斯分布。特征函数方法具有存在性、唯一性和解析可处理性等优势，但缺乏系统性的建模框架和实证验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 特征函数理论、Lévy反演定理、稳定过程和缓变稳定过程理论、Lévy copula理论、Schoenberg复合理论、随机频率混合理论、投资组合投影恒等式、不变律投资组合优化理论。
AI.method: 提出八种参数模型：高斯、椭圆Student-t、高斯混合、方向稳定从属过程、缓变方向稳定、低秩Lévy copula跳跃因子、高斯-Schoenberg复合、随机频率混合；开发加权L2距离度量进行模型比较；提出因子化缺陷检验检测横截面依赖；使用距离相关分析；实证分析16只美国股票2014-2025年数据。
AI.findings: 高斯混合模型在所有模型中拟合效果最佳；所有模型都显示科技与非科技板块间存在显著的跨板块依赖；投资组合投影恒等式在机器精度下得到数值验证；不变律投资组合优化问题可以转化为一维特征函数限制下的泛函优化问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了基于特征函数的多元资产收益率分布全面建模框架；2. 提出了meta-t扩展，在特征函数空间中解耦边际行为与Student-t尾部依赖；3. 证明了不变律投资组合优化问题可以转化为一维特征函数限制下的泛函优化；4. 揭示了经典均值-方差理论是对数特征函数的二阶截断。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了八种参数模型的完整数学推导和特征函数表达式；2. 开发了模型比较的加权L2距离度量和横截面依赖检测的因子化缺陷检验；3. 实证验证了不同模型在真实金融市场数据中的表现；4. 为投资组合优化提供了基于特征函数的新计算框架。

title: Consumer Price Stickiness In The Euro Area During An Inflation Surge
affiliations: Banque de France - Centre de Recherche, Bank of Italy, , Latvijas Banka, Oesterreichische Nationalbank (OeNB), Banco de España, Bank of Lithuania, Deutsche Bundesbank, , Bank of Greece,  and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Consumer Price Stickiness In The Euro Area During An Inflation Surge
detail.abstract: We use CPI micro data for nine euro area countries to document new evidence on consumer price stickiness in the euro area during the 2021-2024 inflation cycle. In 2022, the monthly frequency of price changes reached 12%, compared with an average of 8% over 2010–2019, roughly a four-percentage-point increase; it then fell quickly in 2023 and more slowly in 2024, ending close to its pre-pandemic level. The decline in the frequency of price changes was faster for food and nonenergy industrial goods (NEIG) than for services, where frequencies remained elevated in 2024. The overall frequency rose mainly because there were more price increases, while the magnitude of the average size of the price increases or decreases changed only marginally during the surge. Products with a larger imported-energy cost share responded more strongly, and hazard-rate evidence shows that the probability of price adjustments increases with the gap between actual and optimal prices, consistent with state-dependent pricing and a steepening of the Phillips curve. To illustrate the implications of this state dependence, a macro model suggests that peak inflation would have been almost 1 percentage point lower if the frequency had not responded to the inflation surge.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用欧元区9个国家的CPI微观数据，分析了2021-2024年通胀周期中消费者价格粘性的变化。研究发现，2022年价格变动频率从疫情前的8%上升至12%，随后在2023-2024年回落至接近疫情前水平。价格变动频率上升主要由价格上涨驱动，且进口能源成本占比高的产品反应更强烈。研究支持状态依赖定价理论，并表明价格频率对通胀冲击的响应使通胀峰值提高了近1个百分点。
AI.research_question: 欧元区在2021-2024年通胀周期中消费者价格粘性如何变化？价格变动频率对通胀冲击的响应机制是什么？这种状态依赖定价对整体通胀动态有何影响？
AI.motivation: 理解后疫情时期通胀动态中价格粘性的变化特征，特别是价格调整频率如何响应大规模通胀冲击，这对于评估货币政策传导机制和通胀预测具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 状态依赖定价理论（state-dependent pricing），菲利普斯曲线理论，价格调整的微观基础理论。
AI.method: 使用欧元区9个国家的CPI微观数据，分析价格变动频率、幅度和方向的变化；采用风险率分析检验价格调整概率与实际价格与最优价格差距的关系；构建宏观模型进行反事实分析。
AI.findings: 1. 2022年价格变动频率从疫情前平均8%上升至12%，随后回落；2. 食品和非能源工业品价格频率回落快于服务业；3. 价格变动频率上升主要由价格上涨驱动；4. 进口能源成本占比高的产品反应更强烈；5. 价格调整概率与实际价格与最优价格差距正相关；6. 宏观模型显示，如果价格频率不对通胀冲击响应，通胀峰值会低近1个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 为状态依赖定价理论提供了实证支持，揭示了价格调整频率对通胀冲击的内生响应机制，深化了对菲利普斯曲线斜率变化的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行通胀预测和政策制定提供微观基础，帮助理解通胀动态中的非线性特征，为评估货币政策传导效果提供实证依据。

title:
The 'Weaponisation of Fireworks' and 'Hollowed-Out Command': A Systematic Risk Analysis of Non-Combatant Military Forces 
-A Comparative Institutional Study Centred on Authentic Battlefield Pressure Screening and 'Rank Credibility Capital'
affiliations: The University of Western Australia

detail.title:
The 'Weaponisation of Fireworks' and 'Hollowed-Out Command': A Systematic Risk Analysis of Non-Combatant Military Forces 
-A Comparative Institutional Study Centred on Authentic Battlefield Pressure Screening and 'Rank Credibility Capital'
detail.abstract: Non-combat environments do not inherently diminish military capabilities, but they systematically alter an organisation's feedback structures and promotion signals, thereby inducing two highly correlated risk states: Firstly, the 'weaponry becoming mere pyrotechnics' phenomenon, wherein equipment development and training outputs progressively shift from adversarial validation towards demonstrative proof, with organisations substituting invisible yet critical battlefield effectiveness with visible, reportable metrics; Secondly, 'command hollowing', wherein commanders' capabilities for judgement, coordination, and error correction deteriorate under conditions of high friction, deception, losses, and uncertainty, manifesting as increased reliance on scripted procedures and diminished systemic adaptability. This paper proposes a falsifiable, quantifiable, and reproducible institutional-behaviour-effectiveness framework: with noncombat endurance periods and promotion system performance weights as exogenous conditions, display orientation and script dependency as mediating mechanisms, and command adaptability and combat readiness performance under stress as outcome variables. It introduces the concept of 'rank credibility capital,' translating the notion that 'rank is earned through blood' into a rigorous institutional proposition: For senior ranks to constitute credible signals of command competence, they must correspond to verifiable performance and accountability loops under genuinely high-stakes pressure. When organisations chronically lack such pressure-based selection, rank may undergo symbolic inflation, distorting promotion signals and accelerating hollowing-out. Methodologically, this study explicitly rejects simulation or modelling as substitutes for genuine cost structures. Instead, it employs historical warfare samples, natural experiments, and observational data for comparative identification, ensuring conclusions rest upon the irreplaceable foundation of authentic combat experience. This paper further declares its ethical boundaries: it neither debates the legitimacy of waging war nor advocates any bellicose actions. Its sole purpose is to elucidate capability generation mechanisms and institutional risks within military organisations under varying pressure structures.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个可证伪、可量化、可复制的制度-行为-效能框架，分析非战斗环境如何通过改变组织的反馈结构和晋升信号，导致"武器变成烟花"和"指挥空心化"两种高度相关的风险状态，并提出"军衔可信度资本"概念。
AI.research_question: 非战斗环境如何系统性地改变军事组织的反馈结构和晋升信号，从而影响指挥适应性和战备效能？
AI.motivation: 理解军事组织在长期非战斗环境下能力退化的机制，为预防"和平时期军队空心化"提供理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度-行为-效能框架，包含外生条件（非战斗持续时间、晋升系统权重）、中介机制（展示导向、脚本依赖）、结果变量（指挥适应性、压力下战备效能），以及"军衔可信度资本"概念。
AI.method: 明确拒绝模拟或建模作为真实成本结构的替代，采用历史战争样本、自然实验和观测数据进行比较识别，确保结论建立在真实战斗经验的不可替代基础上。
AI.findings: 非战斗环境导致：1）"武器变成烟花"现象：装备发展和训练从对抗验证转向展示证明；2）"指挥空心化"：指挥官在高摩擦、欺骗、损失和不确定性条件下的判断、协调和纠错能力退化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出可证伪的制度-行为-效能分析框架；2）引入"军衔可信度资本"概念，将"军衔由鲜血赢得"转化为严谨的制度命题；3）阐明晋升信号失真和象征性通胀机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为军事组织诊断和平时期能力退化风险提供分析工具；2）帮助设计更有效的晋升和训练系统；3）为政策制定者提供预防"指挥空心化"的制度设计参考。

title: The Limits of Computation
affiliations: Artificial Intelligence in Finance Institute

detail.title: The Limits of Computation
detail.abstract: We develop a unifying framework for why fundamental limits arise across logic, computation, complexity, information, learning, and modern AI. Classical impossibility results-Gödel incompleteness, Turing undecidability, Rice-type semantic limits, NP-completeness, PCP-based hardness of approximation, Kolmogorov complexity and algorithmic randomness, information-theoretic bounds, and the curse of dimensionality-share common structural features that we organize into a coherent obstruction theory. Our central thesis is an Expressivity-Obstruction Principle: once a formalism can encode self-reference, universal simulation, or robust verification, structural barriers necessarily appear, manifesting as unprovability, undecidability, intractability, inapproximability, or incompressibility. We formalize this as a theorem-schema (Obstruction Emergence) under minimal coding/evaluation and fixed-point assumptions, and provide worked instantiations (Rice, Cook-Levin, proof complexity) demonstrating the schema's operational utility beyond mere synthesis. The framework translates naturally to machine learning: undecidability becomes non-verifiability of global semantic properties, intractability becomes worst-case hardness of training/certification, and information-theoretic limits become identifiability and generalization barriers. We conclude with falsifiable conjectures about verification and alignment in sufficiently expressive learning systems, framing impossibility results as design constraints that inform engineering choices rather than mere theoretical curiosities.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一框架来解释逻辑、计算、复杂性、信息、学习和现代AI中的基本限制。核心是表达性-障碍原则：一旦形式化系统能够编码自引用、通用模拟或鲁棒验证，就会出现结构性障碍，表现为不可证明性、不可判定性、难解性、不可近似性或不可压缩性。
AI.research_question: 为什么哥德尔不完备性、图灵不可判定性、NP完全性、信息论界限等基本限制在不同领域（逻辑、计算、复杂性、信息、学习、AI）中普遍存在？这些限制是否有共同的结构特征和统一的理论框架？
AI.motivation: 经典不可能性结果（哥德尔、图灵、赖斯、NP完全性、PCP近似硬度、柯尔莫哥洛夫复杂性、信息论界限、维度诅咒）看似分散在不同领域，但具有共同的结构特征。需要建立一个统一框架来理解这些基本限制的本质和起源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 表达性-障碍原则：一旦形式化系统能够编码自引用、通用模拟或鲁棒验证，结构性障碍必然出现。障碍涌现定理模式：在最小编码/评估和不动点假设下，障碍必然涌现。统一框架将不同领域的限制联系起来：不可判定性→全局语义属性的不可验证性；难解性→训练/认证的最坏情况硬度；信息论界限→可识别性和泛化障碍。
AI.method: 理论分析框架：1）识别共同结构特征；2）提出表达性-障碍原则；3）形式化为障碍涌现定理模式；4）提供具体实例化（赖斯定理、库克-莱文定理、证明复杂性）；5）将框架自然翻译到机器学习领域；6）提出可证伪的猜想。
AI.findings: 1）不同领域的基本限制具有共同的结构特征；2）表达性-障碍原则能够统一解释这些限制；3）障碍涌现定理模式在最小假设下成立；4）具体实例化验证了该模式的操作实用性；5）框架可自然应用于机器学习，解释验证、训练和泛化的限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）建立了统一框架解释跨领域的基本限制；2）提出了表达性-障碍原则作为核心理论；3）形式化了障碍涌现定理模式；4）展示了框架超越综合的实际操作效用；5）将经典不可能性结果与机器学习限制联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）将不可能性结果重新定义为工程设计约束而非理论奇闻；2）为机器学习系统的验证和对齐提供可证伪的猜想；3）指导工程选择，避免不切实际的目标；4）为AI安全研究提供理论框架；5）帮助理解现代AI系统的根本限制。

title: Gadaa System in Practice, Past and Present
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Gadaa System in Practice, Past and Present
detail.abstract: Broadly speaking, the Gadaa System is an integrated political, social, legal, military, and cultural system of the Oromo nation. As a political system, it is an advanced democratic, egalitarian, and republican system with a clear division of responsibilities and powers among its officials, its institutions, and its branches of government with an instituted vertical and horizontal distribution of state powers and leadership responsibilities. As a legal system, it is an exercise of popular lawmaking that allows the people to make laws that govern them equally, free and fair administration of justice, universal application of the rule of law, community policing and communal crime investigation, the practice of legal and constitutional dynamism where citizens have the opportunity and the privilege to review the laws and the constitution every eight years. As a social system, it is a mechanism for effective stratification of society to age-sets, generation-sets, moiety, sub-moiety, gosa, warra, and balbala, etc. As a military system, it is an effective age-sets and Gadaa-grades based military training, regimentation, mobilization, and deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了奥罗莫民族的加达制度，这是一个集政治、社会、法律、军事和文化于一体的综合系统，展现了其作为先进民主政治体系、人民立法法律体系、社会分层机制和基于年龄组的军事体系的多维特征。
AI.research_question: 加达制度如何作为一个综合性的政治、社会、法律、军事和文化系统运作，其核心特征和运行机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解奥罗莫民族独特的加达制度，探索这一传统系统在民主治理、法律制定、社会组织和军事动员方面的先进性和完整性，为研究传统治理系统提供理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传统治理系统理论、民主共和理论、法律社会学、社会分层理论、军事组织理论
AI.method: 概念分析、系统分析、文献综述、制度分析
AI.findings: 加达制度是一个高度整合的系统，在政治上是先进的民主共和制，在法律上是人民立法和司法体系，在社会上是有效的分层机制，在军事上是基于年龄组的训练和动员体系。

title: Political Shear Stress and the Material Failure of Democratic Agency: Understanding the threat to Science Communication through the Lens of Continuum Mechanics
affiliations: SUNY College at Plattsburgh

detail.title: Political Shear Stress and the Material Failure of Democratic Agency: Understanding the threat to Science Communication through the Lens of Continuum Mechanics
detail.abstract: Contemporary political analysis frequently misdiagnoses the authoritarian moment as a crisis of epistemology (misinformation), assuming that radicalized voters have merely been deceived. We argue that this diagnosis ignores the material reality of the signal itself. In an era where information has become structurally "porous" and stripped of context, the electorate is subjected to a "High-Velocity, Viral Noise" that functions not as an argument, but as a thermodynamic blunt force weapon. This paper proposes a fundamental category shift, arguing that the crisis is one of material science (structure). We introduce and establish a constitutive isomorphism mapping electorate structure and behavior to physical principles including entropy and rheology. We model the electorate not as rational agents seeking truth, but as a Bingham Plastic material subject to industrial-scale Rheological forces. We demonstrate that the thermodynamic exhaustion of the digital ecosystem induces a state of Thermal Softening, lowering the Yield Point (𝜎) of the electorate. This softening is teleologically manipulated by the Political Egoist (acting as a Maxwell's Demon) to force the internalization of empirical contradictions, specifically the rejection of scientific consensus, that exceed the subject's yield strength. Thus, the fracture of the citizen is not a failure of the system, but a Teleological Success. Drawing on the Von Mises Yield Criterion, we posit that in this plastic regime, the voter undergoes an irreversible phase transition: the "Elasticity" of democratic compromise is lost, replaced by the rigid, brittle structure of the "Work-Hardened" agent. This constitutes the Material Failure of Democratic Agency: the citizen loses the structural capacity to return to the equilibrium of shared reality. We conclude that the current strategy of Science Communication, "forceful correction" via fact-checking, is a category error; it applies impact stress to a brittle material, guaranteeing catastrophic fracture. Remediation requires a shift to thermodynamic damping: a "Kinetic Governor" to regulate the strain rate (𝜖) of the information field, restoring the structural conditions required for democratic plasticity.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出政治危机不是认识论问题（错误信息），而是材料科学问题（结构）。作者将选民建模为宾汉塑性材料，数字生态系统的热力学耗竭导致选民屈服点降低，政治利己主义者利用这种软化迫使选民内化矛盾，导致民主代理能力的材料失效。事实核查是范畴错误，需要转向热力学阻尼策略。
AI.research_question: 当代政治危机是认识论危机（错误信息）还是材料科学危机（结构）？数字信息环境如何改变选民的结构特性，导致民主代理能力的失效？
AI.motivation: 当前政治分析错误地将威权主义时刻诊断为认识论危机（错误信息），忽视了信息本身的物质现实。在信息变得"多孔"且缺乏语境的时代，选民遭受"高速、病毒性噪音"的冲击，这种噪音不是论证，而是热力学钝器武器。

2. 热力学原理：熵、热软化、屈服点
3. 流变学：宾汉塑性材料的流变特性
4. 冯·米塞斯屈服准则：塑性变形理论
5. 麦克斯韦妖：政治利己主义者的操纵机制
AI.method: 理论建模方法：建立选民结构与物理原理之间的构成性同构映射，包括熵和流变学。将选民建模为受工业规模流变力作用的宾汉塑性材料，分析数字生态系统的热力学耗竭如何导致屈服点降低和热软化。
AI.findings:

2. 政治利己主义者（作为麦克斯韦妖）利用这种软化迫使选民内化经验矛盾
3. 选民经历不可逆的相变：民主妥协的"弹性"丧失，被"加工硬化"代理的刚性结构取代
4. 这构成了民主代理能力的材料失效：公民失去返回共享现实平衡的结构能力
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出政治分析的根本范畴转变：从认识论危机转向材料科学危机
2. 建立选民行为与物理原理的构成性同构映射
3. 引入宾汉塑性材料模型分析选民行为
4. 提出民主代理能力的材料失效概念
5. 重新概念化政治操纵为热力学过程而非认识论过程

2. 提出补救措施需要转向热力学阻尼：通过"动力学调节器"调节信息场的应变率（𝜖）
3. 为恢复民主可塑性所需的结构条件提供实践指导
4. 为政治沟通和民主治理提供新的干预框架

title: How Purposive Interpretation Shapes Credit Law: Evaluation of Section 3(d) of the National Credit Act
affiliations: University of Johannesburg

detail.title: How Purposive Interpretation Shapes Credit Law: Evaluation of Section 3(d) of the National Credit Act

keywords: and Accessible Credit Market and Industry
Standard Bank of South Africa V Dlamini Case

detail.abstract: The South African Department of Trade and Industry performed a comparative legal research project that suggested enacting the National Credit Act 34 of 2005 (the NCA) to help address SA historical credit law issues.1 Today, the NCA is South Africa's primary legislation governing relationships between credit providers and consumers. The most prevalent problem is that the NCA appears to favour consumer protection and interest above credit providers; this argument can be found in FirstRand Bank Ltd v Mvelase.2 It is therefore essential to ensure that courts and the National Credit Tribunal take a balanced approach when interpreting any provision of the NCA. This was also emphasised in the case of Firstrand Bank v Seyffert,3 to ensure that the purposes stated in section 3 of the NCA are met.

AI.tldr: 南非《国家信贷法》旨在解决历史信贷法律问题，但实践中倾向于过度保护消费者利益，需要法院和信贷法庭在解释法律时采取平衡方法。
AI.research_question: 南非《国家信贷法》在实施过程中是否过度偏向消费者保护，以及如何确保法院和信贷法庭在解释法律条款时采取平衡方法？
AI.motivation: 南非贸易工业部通过比较法律研究项目制定了《国家信贷法》，旨在解决历史信贷法律问题。然而，该法在实践中似乎过度偏向消费者保护，损害了信贷提供者的利益，这在FirstRand Bank Ltd v Mvelase案中有所体现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者保护理论、信贷法律平衡理论、法律解释理论、利益相关者平衡理论
AI.method: 比较法律研究、案例分析（FirstRand Bank Ltd v Mvelase和Firstrand Bank v Seyffert案）、法律文本分析
AI.findings: 《国家信贷法》作为南非主要信贷立法，在实践中倾向于过度保护消费者利益，可能损害信贷提供者的正当权益。法院和信贷法庭需要在解释法律条款时采取更加平衡的方法，以确保实现该法第3条规定的立法目的。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了信贷法律实施中的平衡解释理论，强调了在消费者保护和信贷提供者利益之间寻求平衡的重要性，为信贷法律解释提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为南非法院和信贷法庭提供了法律解释的指导原则，建议在审理信贷案件时采取平衡方法，既保护消费者权益，又维护信贷提供者的合法利益，促进信贷市场的健康发展。

title: Patronage Financing: A Community-Based Approach to Early-Stage SME Enablement

detail.title: Patronage Financing: A Community-Based Approach to Early-Stage SME Enablement

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or animal subjects. Ethical approval was therefore not required.

detail.abstract: Modern economic systems are highly eƯicient at allocating capital to proven actors, yet systematically underperform in supporting early-stage individuals and enterprises whose potential has not yet been realized. This structural bias leads to high failure rates, social fragmentation, and a growing disconnect between economic activity and human meaning. At the same time, digital platforms increasingly resemble large-scale simulations in which individuals are endowed with asymmetric attributes, constraints, and opportunities— much like participants in role-playing or city-building environments. This paper proposes Immanent Teleological Co-Creation (ITCC) as a conceptual framework for re-aligning economic incentives, ethical behavior, and community participation. “Immanent” refers to purpose emerging from within the system rather than being externally imposed; “teleological” denotes directionality toward collective flourishing; and “co-creation” emphasizes the mutual reinforcement among consumers, producers, and capital providers. The framework argues that when patronage, trust, and repeated interaction precede or complement formal capital allocation, ethical behavior becomes economically advantageous rather than morally optional. ITCC is presented as an evolutionary, three-stage model: (1) non-capital patronage that validates trust and demand, (2) risk-aligned capital informed by demonstrated patronage, and (3) community-embedded ownership structures that internalize long-term outcomes. Rather than framing “heaven on earth” as a theological claim, this paper treats it as a metaphor for emergent high-trust equilibria in which honesty, fair dealing, and contribution are systematically rewarded. The paper positions ITCC not as a utopian prescription, but as an architectural lens for designing economic systems that integrate effiiciency with meaning. It concludes by outlining limitations, governance challenges, and directions for future interdisciplinary research and pilot experimentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"内在目的性共创"（ITCC）框架，通过三阶段模型重新调整经济激励、伦理行为和社区参与，旨在解决现代经济系统对早期个人和企业支持不足的结构性偏见问题。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个经济系统框架，既能有效配置资本，又能支持早期个人和企业的潜力发展，同时将经济效率与人类意义相结合？
AI.motivation: 现代经济系统在向已证明的参与者配置资本方面效率很高，但系统性低估早期个人和企业的潜力，导致高失败率、社会分裂以及经济活动与人类意义之间的脱节。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内在目的性共创（ITCC）框架：包含"内在性"（目的从系统内部产生）、"目的性"（朝向集体繁荣的方向性）和"共创"（消费者、生产者和资本提供者之间的相互强化）。
AI.method: 概念性框架开发，提出三阶段进化模型：1）非资本赞助验证信任和需求；2）基于已证明赞助的风险调整资本；3）社区嵌入式所有权结构内化长期结果。
AI.findings: 当赞助、信任和重复互动先于或补充正式资本配置时，伦理行为变得经济有利而非道德可选。ITCC框架可作为设计整合效率与意义的经济系统的架构视角。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了ITCC理论框架，将经济激励、伦理行为和社区参与重新对齐；发展了"人间天堂"作为高信任均衡的隐喻；为经济系统设计提供了新的架构视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、平台设计者和企业家提供了具体的三阶段实施模型；指出了治理挑战和未来跨学科研究及试点实验的方向；为解决早期创新者融资困境提供了新思路。

title: Solver-in-the-Loop: MDP-Based Benchmarks for Self-Correction and Behavioral Rationality in Operations Research
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Institute for Data, Systems, and Society (IDSS), Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - School of Engineering and Alibaba Group

detail.title: Solver-in-the-Loop: MDP-Based Benchmarks for Self-Correction and Behavioral Rationality in Operations Research
detail.abstract: Operations Research practitioners routinely debug infeasible models through an iterative process: analyzing Irreducible Infeasible Subsystems (IIS), identifying constraint conflicts, and systematically repairing formulations until feasibility is achieved. Yet existing LLM benchmarks evaluate OR as one-shot translationgiven a problem description, generate solver code-ignoring this diagnostic loop entirely. We introduce two benchmarks that place the solver in the evaluation loop. OR-Debug-Bench evaluates iterative self-correction through 5,000+ problems spanning 9 error types; each repair action triggers solver re-execution and IIS recomputation, providing deterministic, verifiable feedback. OR-Bias-Bench evaluates behavioral rationality through 2,000 newsvendor instances (1,000 ID + 1,000 OOD), measuring systematic deviations from closed-form optimal policies. Across 26 models and 12,000+ samples, we find that domain-specific RLVR training enables an 8B model to surpass frontier APIs: 95.3% vs 86.2% recovery rate (+9.1%), 62.4% vs 47.8% diagnostic accuracy (+14.6%), and 2.25 vs 3.78 steps to resolution (1.7× faster). On OR-Bias-Bench, curriculum training achieves the only negative ID→OOD bias drift among models evaluated (-9.6%), reducing systematic bias by 48% (from 20.0% to 10.4%). These results demonstrate that process-level evaluation with verifiable oracles enables targeted training that outperforms scale.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了两个新的运筹学（OR）基准测试：OR-Debug-Bench评估LLM在迭代调试不可行模型中的表现，OR-Bias-Bench评估LLM在报童问题中的行为理性偏差。研究发现，经过领域特定训练的较小模型可以超越前沿API模型。
AI.research_question: 如何评估大型语言模型在运筹学问题中的迭代调试能力和行为理性？领域特定训练能否使较小模型超越规模更大的前沿模型？
AI.motivation: 现有LLM基准测试将运筹学问题视为一次性代码生成任务，忽略了实践中关键的迭代调试过程。需要新的评估框架来反映真实的运筹学工作流程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于运筹学实践中的不可约不可行子系统（IIS）调试理论，以及报童问题中的行为理性偏差理论框架。
AI.method: 设计了两个基准测试：1）OR-Debug-Bench：包含5000+个问题，涵盖9种错误类型，通过求解器循环评估迭代自校正能力；2）OR-Bias-Bench：包含2000个报童实例，评估模型与闭式最优策略的系统性偏差。
AI.findings: 经过领域特定RLVR训练的8B模型在多个指标上超越前沿API模型：恢复率95.3% vs 86.2%，诊断准确率62.4% vs 47.8%，解决步骤减少1.7倍。在OR-Bias-Bench中，课程训练实现了唯一的负ID→OOD偏差漂移，系统性偏差减少48%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于过程级评估的新理论框架，强调可验证的反馈机制在LLM评估中的重要性。证明了领域特定训练可以超越规模优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了两个实用的运筹学基准测试工具，支持运筹学从业者评估和改进LLM在实际问题中的表现。展示了如何通过针对性训练提升较小模型在专业领域的性能。
